dem_source: AWS Terrarium (elevation-tiles-prod), zoom 12, ~30-38 m native, resampled to 30 m in UTM 43N
method: pysheds D8 flow accumulation; catchment from Idukki dam pour point minus catchment from Mullaperiyar dam pour point (upstream trans-basin diversion to the Vaigai basin, Tamil Nadu, via tunnel - invisible to a DEM, which sees only topography, not the tunnel)
